mapper.select: select id, user_id, scenic_area_id, route_name, geojson, spot_ids_json, spot_names_json, distance_meters, spot_count, road_segment_count, create_time, update_time from agent_route_geo where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into agent_route_geo ( user_id, scenic_area_id, route_name, geojson, spot_ids_json, spot_names_json, distance_meters, spot_count, road_segment_count, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{scenicAreaId}, #{routeName}, #{geojson}, #{spotIdsJson}, #{spotNamesJson}, #{distanceMeters}, #{spotCount}, #{roadSegmentCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
